title: Step 2 - Sequence groups"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

# Preparations

Load the necessary libraries

```{r libraries}
library(ape)          #for DNA sequences and distances
library(ggplot2)      #for plots
library(cluster)      #for silhouette analysis
library(DECIPHER)     #for aligning sequences
```

# Read and align sequences

The sequences are different lengths, so I aligned them before calculating distances.

```{r}
files <- list.files("../working_sequences", full.names = TRUE)
seqs <- readDNAStringSet(files)

aligned <- AlignSeqs(seqs)
dna_alignment <- as.DNAbin(aligned)
```

# Pairwise distances

```{r}
jc_dist <- dist.dna(dna_alignment, model = "JC69")
```

# PCoA

```{r}
pcoa_result <- cmdscale(jc_dist, k = 10, eig = TRUE)

pcoa_df <- as.data.frame(pcoa_result$points)
colnames(pcoa_df) <- paste0("PCoA", 1:10)

eig <- pcoa_result$eig
variance <- 100 * eig / sum(eig[eig > 0])

# get outlet name from the header (before the |)
pcoa_df$Outlet <- sub("\\|.*", "", rownames(pcoa_df))
```

```{r}
p1 <- ggplot(pcoa_df, aes(x = PCoA1, y = PCoA2, colour = Outlet)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  labs(x = paste0("PCoA1 (", round(variance[1], 1), "%)"),
       y = paste0("PCoA2 (", round(variance[2], 1), "%)"),
       title = "PCoA coloured by outlet") +
  theme_classic()
p1
ggsave("pcoa_by_outlet.png", p1)
```

# Silhouette analysis

```{r}
set.seed(123)
pcoa_coords <- pcoa_df[, paste0("PCoA", 1:10)]
pcoa_dist <- dist(pcoa_coords)

k_values <- 2:10
mean_silhouette <- numeric(length(k_values))

for (i in seq_along(k_values)) {
  km_test <- kmeans(pcoa_coords, centers = k_values[i], nstart = 25)
  sil <- silhouette(km_test$cluster, pcoa_dist)
  mean_silhouette[i] <- mean(sil[, "sil_width"])
}

data.frame(k = k_values, mean_silhouette = round(mean_silhouette, 3))

plot(k_values, mean_silhouette, type = "b", pch = 19,
     xlab = "Number of clusters (k)", ylab = "Mean silhouette width")
```

# k-means

```{r}
optimal_k <- k_values[which.max(mean_silhouette)]
optimal_k

set.seed(123)
km_optimal <- kmeans(pcoa_coords, centers = optimal_k, nstart = 25)
pcoa_df$Group <- factor(km_optimal$cluster)
```

```{r}
p2 <- ggplot(pcoa_df, aes(x = PCoA1, y = PCoA2, colour = Group)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.9) +
  labs(x = paste0("PCoA1 (", round(variance[1], 1), "%)"),
       y = paste0("PCoA2 (", round(variance[2], 1), "%)"),
       title = "PCoA coloured by group") +
  theme_classic()
p2
ggsave("pcoa_by_group.png", p2)
```

# Groups vs outlets

```{r}
table(pcoa_df$Outlet, pcoa_df$Group)
```
